manifest.name: poe-code
manifest.description: CLI tool to configure Poe API for developer workflows.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-workspaces.mjs && npm run codegen:plan-schemas && npm run codegen:harness-schemas && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/generate-bin-wrappers.mjs && node scripts/bundle.mjs
scripts.check:semver: node -e "const semver=require('semver'); const pkg=require('./package.json'); if(!semver.valid(pkg.version)){console.error('Invalid semver version in package.json:', pkg.version); process.exit(1);}"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:eslint && npm run lint:types && npm run lint:workflows
scripts.lint:types: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck:contracts --workspace=@poe-code/safe-js && npm run typecheck:contracts --workspace=tiny-mcp-client

manifest.name: @poe-platform/safe-bash
manifest.description: Extensible virtual shell with pluggable filesystems and streaming commands

manifest.name: @poe-platform/safe-fs
manifest.description: Composable filesystem with a portable core and explicit Node adapters

manifest.name: @poe-platform/safe-js
manifest.description: Budgeted JavaScript interpreter with explicit host capabilities and resumable execution
